items.title: OpenAI fires three safety researchers for "mishandling research information"
items.blurb: Three fired OpenAI safety researchers dispute allegations of mishandling sensitive information, warning in an open letter that their dismissals are creating a chilling effect on the company’s AI safety culture.

items.blurb: Google has released Android Bench 2.0, a major update to its benchmark framework for evaluating AI models and agents on Android development tasks.

items.title: Github Migrates Copilot Runtime to Rust with AI-Assisted Rewrite
